name: Lurking For Love
source:
You’re settling down in a suburban town in Texas, starting a new life for yourself. Lately, your mail has been getting sent to the wrong house and keeps ending up at your neighbor’s front door. Or at least, that’s what he told you.

Your polite neighbor Jacob has been returning your mail quite often lately. It’s almost like he wants to talk to you more... 

Lurking For Love is a Horror/Murder Dating Sim visual novel game featuring Jacob Alden, a lonesome man who has quite the interest in you.

[From [url=https://sinistershrike.itch.io/lurking-for-love-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你正在得克萨斯州的一座郊区小镇安顿下来，开始新生活。最近，你的邮件总被送错地方，出现在邻居家门前。至少，他是这么告诉你的。

彬彬有礼的邻居Jacob近来经常替你送回邮件。简直像是想多找机会跟你说说话……

《Lurking For Love》是一款融合恐怖、谋杀与恋爱模拟的视觉小说。主角之一Jacob Alden是个孤独的男人，对你抱有相当浓厚的兴趣。

[摘自[url=https://sinistershrike.itch.io/lurking-for-love-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
